# WOD Tracker

> WOD Tracker is a training log for CrossFit, weightlifting and hybrid athletes on iPhone,
> Android, Apple Watch and Wear OS. It has 81 built-in benchmark WODs, timers for EMOM,
> AMRAP, Tabata and For Time, and an automatic personal record and one-rep max for every
> movement. It works offline, and training data stays on the device unless the user turns
> on cloud backup or asks the AI coach.

## What it does

- **Timers**: EMOM, AMRAP, For Time and Tabata, set up the way the athlete trains, with
  audio cues, a time cap, saved presets, a full-screen clock and a rest timer.
- **Benchmark library**: 81 WODs that ship inside the app and work offline: 21 Girls,
  40 Heroes, 7 named workouts and 13 CrossFit Open workouts. Each starts its timer from the
  same card, and the athlete can race their last attempt or their PR round by round.
- **Log**: every set with weight, reps and a note, filterable by lifts or WODs.
- **Progress**: personal record, estimated one-rep max (Epley and Brzycki), total volume,
  average weight and set count for any movement, with the full history as a chart.
- **Analytics** (Premium): training health, training load, consistency, plateau detection and strength ratios.
- **Watch**: Apple Watch and Wear OS companions run the timers, log sets and a rest timer.
  Sets logged while the phone is out of range are queued and delivered when it reconnects.
  Heart rate is shown during a workout and is never stored or uploaded by the app.
- **AI coach** (PRO): workout suggestions from the logged history, post-workout insight and
  recovery recommendations. Replies come from Google Gemini and the app asks before it sends
  anything. General information only, not medical advice.

## Platforms

- iPhone and Apple Watch (SwiftUI, with Apple Health sync).
- Android and Wear OS (Jetpack Compose).
- 19 interface languages (including Traditional Chinese); store listings in 22.

## Pricing

- Free: unlimited lifts, sets and history, all 81 benchmark WODs, all timers, automatic
  personal records and 1RM, three workout templates, data export (CSV or JSON) and restore,
  a lock screen Live Activity on iPhone, Apple Watch and Wear OS.
- Premium: unlimited templates, multi-week programs, advanced analytics and plateau
  detection, cloud backup and auto-sync, Timer Studio, voice logging, supersets and circuits,
  Apple Health sync and body composition, warm-up generator and recovery dashboard.
- PRO: everything in Premium plus the AI coach, animated exercise demos and form check.
- A free trial applies when the store offers one for your account. Prices are set per country
  by the App Store and Google Play.

## Built by

Manuel Lorenzo Parejo, as a one-person project. One Kotlin Multiplatform codebase holds the
data and domain layers, and each platform keeps its own native UI.
